messages.snippet: James, Sarah, Attached is our mark-up of the Subscription Agreement (tracked). Key points: (i) found
messages.subject: Project Drake — investor mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Sarah,

Attached is our mark-up of the Subscription Agreement (tracked). Key points: (i) founder liability cap increased to £2,000,000; (ii) basket increased to £250,000; (iii) the general warranty survival period extended to the third anniversary; and (iv) the founder non-compete extended to 18 months. Most other points are minor. Happy to talk these through.

Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP

messages.snippet: Marcus, Aisha, Investor mark-up in. Four points of substance (see Oliver's note). My recommendation:
messages.subject: FW: Project Drake — investor mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Aisha,

Investor mark-up in. Four points of substance (see Oliver's note). My recommendation: we can live with the £2m founder cap and 18-month non-compete, and the 3-year survival is standard. I'd push back on the basket — propose £225k as a midpoint. None of this is unusual; we should be able to settle quickly.

Shall we hold a 20-minute call tomorrow?

Sarah
